title: E2E: Signup flow with migration checkbox
description: Playwright e2e test for the complete signup flow including migration preference checkbox, magic link sending, and localStorage handling.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test: Signup page renders with email, display name, migration checkbox
Test: Migration checkbox is checked by default
Test: Form validation - email required, display name 3-20 chars
Test: Clicking 'Send Magic Link' stores preferences in localStorage
Test: localStorage keys set: songscript_migrate_on_signup, songscript_signup_display_name
Test: Unchecking migration checkbox stores 'false' in localStorage
All tests pass: bun run test:e2e --grep 'auth-signup'
